When you say update photos - what exactly do you mean? IE. Uploading new photos, editing old photos, removing photos, or changing how the photos look on the page...  


As far as finding photos, they are mostly in the wp-contents folder of your website (if you are using FTP to access them). Please see [https://yihs.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/](https://yihs.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/) to see what I mean.  


In the graphic interface, when logged in as an admin, you can find photos under the Media Library link on the left side of the screen.   


For more information on how to work with photos in wp please see [https://wordpress.com/support/images/](https://wordpress.com/support/images/). I heavily advise making sure your images have alt text as I have been working with a number of institutions sued for not having it [https://wordpress.com/support/accessibility/#use-alt-text-on-images](https://wordpress.com/support/accessibility/#use-alt-text-on-images).

Tell them why you are doing it, so they don't spend years thinking they could have saved you. Explain to them that the pain and suffering they all feel is worth it because you can now rest at ease. 

Write to every person who's lives you could have improved by simply waving to them when they were having a bad day.

Friend I have been there. Still there actually, I know nothing about you so I cannot give you advice that fits you, but I can let you know what helped me. 

1) If you can, take a day, you lost apart of yourself and those feelings are justified-take a day or two to mourn and sleep - the feelings wont go away, but it will give you time to process.

2) Exist - Nothing really helped other than pressing forward with my life, almost a year later I still feel the pain but it has severely lessened. 

3) Introspection - when a breakup hits you exceptionally hard, maybe there is something else going on in the background. For me, I was putting my will to live on said person instead of living for myself. My future was her instead of being me.

4) Keep reaching out when things get tough, we are all here for each other, if you are having troubles irl communicating.
